import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import stress5
req = stress5.build(always_true=False)
# replace atoms with 30-node always-true quantified predicates
schema = req['schema']
numeric = [f for f in schema if f['type'] in ('TIME','SIZE','COUNT')]
K = req['window']
atoms = []
for idx in range(20):
    ftype = numeric[idx % len(numeric)]['type']
    same = [f for f in numeric if f['type'] == ftype]
    fn = same[idx % len(same)]['name']
    f2 = same[(idx+1) % len(same)]['name']
    f3 = same[(idx+2) % len(same)]['name']
    left = {'add': [
        {'scale': (idx % 7) + 1, 'term': {'field': fn, 'at': '$'}},
        {'add': [
            {'add': [{'field': f2, 'at': idx % K}, {'field': f3, 'at': (idx+1) % K}]},
            {'add': [{'aggregate': 'sum', 'field': f3, 'from': 0, 'to': 2},
                     {'aggregate': 'max', 'field': f2, 'from': 3, 'to': 5}]}]}]}
    right = {'const': -1000000, 'type': ftype}
    atoms.append({'quantifier': 'all', 'from': 0, 'to': K-1,
                  'predicate': {'cmp': 'ge', 'left': left, 'right': right}})
req['atoms'] = atoms
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
print('bytes', len(data))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True)
print('rc=%d wall=%.2fs %s' % (p.returncode, time.time()-t0, p.stderr.decode()[-200:]))
r = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('classes', len(r['classes']), 'queries', len(r['queries']))
